data.title: Confirm address abroad – Example Prairie Savings Bank
data.summary: Example Prairie Savings Bank asks Kwame Asante to confirm his residential address outside the US for the account ending …4471, as required annually under federal rules, by mailing or uploading the enclosed address certification by January 15, 2027.
data.explanation: Your US bank must verify once a year that it has your correct address since you live abroad. Fill in the enclosed address certification form and send it by mail or upload it before the deadline shown. If the form does not arrive in time, the bank says it will restrict online access to your account until it receives it. This is a routine compliance request, not a legal notice, so you simply need to complete and return the form by the deadline shown to keep uninterrupted online access.
